description: Read one work's record in the Bibliothèque nationale de France catalogue, by the identifier search_works returns. It carries the title, everyone the record credits, the date the BnF gives the work, its language, its form and its subject with the Dewey class. 'forms' holds the work-form vocabulary's own terms, which carry no label in this dataset, so some read as words and some do not. A record stating none has a form the catalogue does not state. 'status' says whether the record is established or provisional, and 'status_statement' repeats what the catalogue itself states. A provisional identifier can change, so cite an established one where there is a choice. 'expression_count' counts the expressions the record links, which is not a count of published editions: use list_editions for those.

include_depictions.description: Include the images data.bnf.fr attaches to the work. A well-known work can carry dozens, so they are left out by default. find_digitised gathers them alongside the digitised editions.

work_id.description: The identifier from search_works, such as 'cb11970626n' or 'temp-work/22d7f68c1a4bdd081ad7ca791fd3b730'.

name: get_work

depiction_count.description: Images on Gallica that the record points at, counted whether or not they were returned.

ark.description: The Gallica ARK identifying the document.

from_id.description: The record this link hangs off.

rendering.description: The view the address asks Gallica for, read off what follows the ARK name in it, such as 'thumbnail' for a small image or 'item' for one leaf. Null when the address names the document itself. This says what was asked for, not what comes back.

role.description: 'reproduction' is the edition itself digitised. 'ocr' is the text a machine read off it. 'depiction' is an image illustrating the record, which can be a portrait or a page mentioning the subject rather than the work.

url.description: The address the catalogue publishes, for a person to open. Read it beside 'rendering': an address asking for a rendering opens that view of the document rather than the document. This server does not read either.

retrieved_at.description: When these metadata were read from data.bnf.fr, as an ISO 8601 instant. The BnF licence asks for this date to be stated wherever the metadata are shown, so repeat it alongside the source.

catalogue_url.description: The address of this record in the BnF general catalogue, as the record itself points at it. Null when the record states none, which is the ordinary case on work records: it is a silence in the record rather than a record the general catalogue lacks, and no address is built in its place.

date.description: The date the record gives the work, as published.

expression_count.description: Expressions the record links: translations, adaptations, recordings. This is not a count of published editions. Null when the record was longer than one query reads, since the number would then be the ceiling rather than the count.

forms.description: Terms of the BnF work-form vocabulary, as the terms themselves. The vocabulary publishes no label for them here, so they are not translated: some read as words, such as 'poesi', and some do not, such as 'te'. An empty list is a form the record does not state.

status_statement.description: What the record itself states, such as 'fully established' or 'provisional'.

subjects.description: Subjects in the words of the record.

title: Read a work's record
